title: Words to read and colour: Al-Kafirun
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: An-Nasr, Al-Kafirun and reading joined words
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 36. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Al-Kafirun). Then trace and copy.

arabic.text: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ (١) لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ (٢) وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ (٣) وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ (٤) وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ (٥) لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ (٦)

panels.title: What it teaches
points: We do not join other worship
We are kind and fair to everyone

questions.q: Say Al-Kafirun together, counting ayat on fingers.
Listening turns: today's group says Al-Kafirun to the teacher. Everyone else draws six circles on the pupil PDF and numbers them 1 to 6 while saying each ayah.
Extend: say Al-Kafirun to a grown-up before bed.

questions.a: A) Allah alone. We worship Allah alone (tawhid).

questions.q: Think again: Allah taught the Prophet ﷺ to say clearly who he worships. Why is it good to be clear about this?
questions.a: So everyone knows we worship Allah alone; we can still be kind and polite to all people.
